CAPABILITY — softlock/runaway/state: v2 lib/vm/paths.py private canonical state/profile validation and lock order; lib/vm/lifecycle.sh identity-bound QEMU argv/executable/disk/socket/listener checks, deadlines, refusal on ambiguity, no force-kill; descendant guard blocks unsafe suspend/delete. State root from lib/state.sh:4–6 = MESTER_STATE_DIR or XDG_DATA_HOME/HOME/.local/share/little-mester, outside checkout; ignored .mester runtime data is not trust/authorization. Do not import v2 recursion/profile manager into Phase 1.

CAPABILITY — security: legacy docs/vm-architecture.md and decisions describe one selected workspace, loopback SSH, restrict=on and mediated proxy, no host Docker/socket, no published ports, guest-only Docker and credentials outside VM. #49 imposes stricter D1–D10: trusted Host Launcher alone creates/destroys, host-authorized caller identity, one workspace/VM, capabilities default off, max one disposable Test VM/no recursion, security controls outside agent-editable workspace. Old branches do not prove this contract.

CAPABILITY — guest Docker conflict: v2 guest-bootstrap.sh:251–299 installs Docker CE/CLI/containerd/buildx/compose, proxy, enables rootful system docker.service and adds mester to docker group; native agent runs directly in guest. v1 cloud-init was rootless-service approach. This conflicts with legacy C.8 rootless default; no topology/privilege assumption is authorized by #49 beyond Phase 1 guest Docker execution—Sol must resolve before reuse.

SUCCESSOR TICKET PROPOSAL (not created): Objective: only #49 milestone clean checkout→authorized Dev VM with one selected workspace→Little Mester responds→guest Docker runs one test container. Candidate files after Sol review: lab dispatch; new minimal lib/vm-v3 host launcher/shared authorization+lifecycle core; guest provisioning/bootstrap; focused unit tests and one owner-run smoke runbook. Reuse only v2 private-path validation, bounded runner logs/rollback, input validation/rendering ideas. Do not reuse recursion, broad config/profile/update/auth/metrics/campaign subsystems, guest-controlled policy, extra mounts, host Docker. Exact filenames require architecture review.

ORDER/constraints: (1) document precise host identity/capability source and boundary; (2) tests first: unauthorized launch, workspace substitution/path escape, default-disabled capability, second Test VM/recursion, failed startup rollback; (3) implement shared core, thin CLI/MCP adapters; no privilege grants from guest; (4) boot pinned Dev VM exporting one workspace only, no host socket/published ports; (5) verify Little Mester request/response and guest Docker container exit; (6) run local tests, then owner-authorized host smoke with preserved diagnostics; cohesive commit only after evidence. No automatic VM replacement/deletion; preserve old branches and host-Docker session.

Successor AC proposal: A1 host core authorizes launch against actual caller and exact workspace; negative requests denied. A2 capability defaults disabled; at most one explicitly authorized disposable Test VM; recursion denied. A3 workspace/config cannot modify host policy; no host Docker, secrets, extra paths or published ports. A4 clean checkout launches Dev VM and Little Mester responds. A5 guest Docker runs a container and reports successful exit; daemon privilege must match explicit reviewed decision. A6 bounded startup/rollback diagnostics and owner-observed evidence recorded. Test commands above are NOT_RUN candidates; exact v3 commands and owner-run host smoke must be settled from chosen API and current #41 handoff before ticket creation.
